chapter.heading: Hebrews 3
Jesus Greater Than Moses
chapter.v: the apostle and high priest of our confession,
just as Moses also was faithful in all God's house.
For Jesus has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses—as much more glory as the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself.
the builder of all things is God.)
to testify to the things that were to be spoken later,
hold fast our confidence and our boasting in our hope.
on the day of testing in the wilderness,
they have not known my ways.’
if indeed we hold our original confidence firm to the end.
do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion.”
all those who left Egypt led by Moses?
whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
they would not enter his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
they were unable to enter because of unbelief.

footnotes.footnote: 3:6 Some manuscripts insert *firm to the end*
